title: WODCraft compiled document
description: The interchange format produced by compiling a .wod document (WODCraft 1.2, SPEC §13). A document is stamped with the oldest version that holds it: one that uses no 1.1 or 1.2 construct is still stamped "1.0" and validates as before.

amount.description: A single number, or one value per category when the source used a dual (43/30).

source.description: 1-based position of the statement in the source file.

load.description: A load, always exposed in kilograms and pounds.

unit.description: the unit written in the source

value.description: resolved workouts only: the value in the athlete's units

unit.description: the unit written in the source

distance.description: a per-rep distance, e.g. ten 25 m shuttle runs

factor.description: 1.1, resolved workouts only — a movement without a quantity (it takes the ladder value) done factor times

or.description: 1.1 — the other options of an alternative (10 Ring row | 8 Scapular pull-up): the athlete does this movement or one of these

reps_open.description: the ladder continues with the same step until the cap

there_and_back.description: 1.1 — the items in order, then in reverse back to the first one, without repeating the last

attempts.description: 1.2, max_load only — the best of N attempts counts; a trailing rest comes between the attempts

used.description: the block came from a 'use' line

capped.description: what is scored by an athlete who hits the cap

there_and_back.description: 1.1 — the scored block is done there and back: a round is the whole path

aggregate.description: 1.2 — score: VALUE, total: the parts (multi) or the efforts of the block add up to one score

unit.description: 1.2, multi with aggregate only — what every part measures and the total adds up

parts.description: score == multi: one entry per timed block

level_operation.description: One adaptation applied by a level (Scaled:, Foundations:…) or by the athlete's Adapted: block.

when.description: restricts the operation to the occurrences carrying these parameters

distance.description: a per-rep distance, e.g. ten 25 m shuttle runs

factor.description: 1.1 — A -> 2x B: the quantities of every occurrence are multiplied

quantity.description: 1.1 — A -> 10 B: the quantity of every occurrence is replaced

blocks.description: The body of the workout. Usually blocks; a body written as a bare movement line (a strength piece) or a rest keeps that item at the top level.

cap_s.description: 1.2 — the cap of the whole workout (cap:) when its body holds several blocks; a single block carries it itself

adapted.description: 1.1 — the athlete's Adapted: block, applied after the chosen level (SPEC §9.1)

resolved.description: present once the workout has been resolved for an athlete (SPEC §14)

adapted.description: 1.1 — the Adapted: block was applied after the level
